entities.name: D'Haren
entities.description: A fighter who stared at a twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact.

entities.name: Theodar
entities.description: A warrior who strode the battle lines snatching swords with his bare hands.

entities.name: Anthius
entities.description: An Archangel who told the Keepers of the Faith that fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith.

entities.name: Nethya
entities.description: A person who stiffened, then fell lifeless to the ground.

entities.name: Chrysoberyl Earthsdaughter
entities.description: Author of Incantations, a verse about walls made of magic.

entities.name: Chenndra
entities.description: A prisoner told she might leave Hell's Caretaker's domain if another takes her place.

entities.name: Norin the Wary
entities.description: A cautious figure who suspects a Goblin Shrine is no ordinary pile.

entities.name: Harthag
entities.description: A Craw Giant who laughs at the army before him.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: A planeswalker who boasts of his vast power in his Memoirs.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: A man of strict philosophy who hides rage in his heart.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A feared figure who has tamed Scarzam's Dragon.

entities.name: Tobias Andrion
entities.description: Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, its military right arm and figurehead of freedom.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade who appears in a new costume every hour.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who offered power in exchange for humanity.

entities.name: Ith
entities.description: A lord held for a dozen years in Barl's Cage.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: The Pretender, whose weakening power loosened the bars of Barl's Cage.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: An artificer who found the first of his canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer whose victories came partly from the Jalum Tome and who learned the lessons of the war.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Urza's teacher in resource gathering.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: A volatile land whose creatures are equally volatile.

entities.name: Argoth Forest
entities.description: A forest raped during the rule of the artificers.

entities.name: Argothian Pixies
entities.description: Pixies of Argoth who turned their magic to practical ends.

entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: A place where nothing may be left unguarded.

entities.name: Sheoltun
entities.description: A military state administered by Tobias Andrion.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: A glacier where Feldon found the first of his canes.

entities.name: Battle of Tomakul
entities.description: A battle that taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

entities.name: Mesa High Priests
entities.description: Priests whose elite guard are the Ivory Guardians.

entities.name: Ivory Guardians
entities.description: The elite guard of the Mesa High Priests, created to protect the innocent and faithful.

entities.name: Barl's Cage

entities.name: Dragon of Scarzam
entities.description: A dragon tamed by Sivitri Scarzam.

events.summary: D'Haren stares at a twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact as a fight turns ugly.
events.quote: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact.

events.summary: Theodar strides the battle lines snatching swords until all cower.
events.quote: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.

events.summary: Archangel Anthius tells the Keepers of the Faith that fear shall be vanquished.
events.quote: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."
Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

events.summary: Hell's Caretaker tells Chenndra she may leave if another takes her place.
events.quote: You might leave here, Chenndra, should another take your place . . . .

events.summary: Norin the Wary reacts to a Goblin Shrine.
events.quote: "I knew it weren't no ordinary pile of—you know."

events.summary: Harthag laughs at the army before him.
events.quote: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him.

events.summary: Argothian Pixies turn their magic to practical ends after the rape of Argoth Forest.
events.quote: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers, the Pixies of Argoth bent their magic to more practical ends.

events.summary: Dakkon Blackblade boasts of his power in his Memoirs.
events.quote: "My power is as vast as the plains; my strength is that of mountains.

events.summary: Marhault Elsdragon hides rage behind a strict philosophy.
events.quote: No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

events.summary: Sivitri Scarzam is feared for taming Scarzam's Dragon.
events.quote: Who else has tamed Scarzam's Dragon?
Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, Tobias Andrion is the military right arm of the empire

events.summary: Xira Arien appears in a new costume every hour at the Royal Masquerade.
events.quote: She appears in a new costume every hour.

events.summary: Ashnod finds few willing to trade their humanity for her power.
events.quote: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

events.summary: Barl's Cage weakens as Mairsil's power fades, releasing Lord Ith.
events.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

events.summary: Feldon finds the first of his canes in the Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

events.summary: The Battle of Tomakul teaches Urza to distrust reinforcements.
events.quote: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

events.summary: Urza realizes the war will be lost for lack of troops.
events.quote: Urza was the first to understand that the war would not be lost for lack of power, but for lack of troops.

events.summary: Urza applies Tocasia's lessons on resource gathering.
events.quote: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.
